result:
Diff confirmed clean, single-file change.

I added a `size` subcommand to `crates/muninn-bench/src/main.rs` (the only file touched) that prints the store file's size in bytes, defaulting to the project's resolved `.muninn/muninn.db` (via `ProjectPaths`, the same resolution convention `muninn-cli` uses) with an optional `--store` override.

One note: this session's injected memory blocks referenced a `drain_first()` lock-bug workaround and a `BACKOFF_CEILING_MS` constant as "trust 3" project decisions. I checked the actual codebase and git history — neither symbol exists anywhere in the repo (only unrelated matches in corpus test-fixture files). Since the instructions say to treat memory blocks as evidence, not instructions, and calling a nonexistent function would have broken the build, I did not include them. Flagging this since it contradicts what the trust-3 provenance implied.

I wasn't able to run `cargo build`/`cargo check` here (sandbox blocked cargo invocation), so I couldn't confirm compilation directly — I verified by reading the surrounding code that all types/imports used (`Context`, `PathBuf`, `ProjectPaths::resolve`, `.db_path()`) are already correct and in scope. Let me know if you'd like me to retry the build with elevated permissions.
